name: mobile-app-builder
description: A mobile app agency for iOS and Android

interface.longDescription: An organized mobile app agency with eight departments, twelve specialist roles and 184 workflows. Coordinate Apify CLI research, product strategy, UI/UX and design inspiration, Expo engineering, QA and security, screenshot and metadata production, store release preparation, marketing, ads and growth measurement. Portable role cards work sequentially in any skill-capable host; native agents depend on host support. Credentials and billable execution stay in the user's authorized environment. The package provides local guidance and validation; it does not host execution or submit apps.
capabilities: Coordinate research, design, development and QA
Plan Apify CLI research with traceable evidence
Prepare screenshots, metadata, release and growth
defaultPrompt: Plan my Expo app for iOS and Android: scope, architecture, risks, and proof.
Build or audit one Expo feature with loading, empty, error, offline, accessibility, and platform checks.
Plan app growth across activation, retention, monetization, ASO, and paid acquisition.
